entries.question: Local stage approval identity
entries.decision_delta: Separate node-local definitions, Previews and reviews from whole-graph revision. Bind concrete import content, issuer, policy, target and guards, not only types.

entries.question: Cursor recovery after permanent failure
entries.decision_delta: Keep normal commit eligibility separate from exact exceptional claims under management authority. Explicitly abandon or hand off known unmet duties; retain unknown evidence and reconciliation obligations.

entries.question: Capture classification defaults
entries.decision_delta: Inherit published SourceView/Connector-instance defaults during capture. Distinguish absent from unknown/invalid labels and decide ModelTask egress independently.

entries.question: Stamp declaration, visibility and authority
entries.decision_delta: Declare management-write capability and horizon; check combined business/stamp permissions, separate Preview display, known denial at check and current execution preflight.

entries.question: Derive and explicit field selection
entries.decision_delta: Map derive uses snapshot/add-only semantics. Ordered-array derive supports prior slots, input shadowing and input retention. Select closes the output shape.

entries.question: Minimal identity roles
entries.decision_delta: Target and item reuse domain values. Logical locator and exact dispatch key are distinct runtime roles; avoid unnecessary dedicated identity artifacts.

entries.question: Semantic risk routing
entries.decision_delta: Reject source Effect/stage counts and proxies as routing authority. Evaluate actual scope, items, amounts, permissions and uncertainty, retaining cumulative budgets.

entries.question: Independent authoring evaluation
entries.decision_delta: Evaluate stage and derive authoring independently with sealed tasks and hidden oracles. Record only actual attempts, errors and measured outcomes; evaluation does not register new syntax.
